draft.goal: Qualify existing failed-result attribution without duplicate implementation or fabricated Native measurements.

tasks.goal: Exercise saved FAILED reason priority and confirmed-versus-self-reported deliveries; repair demonstrated defects, verify a pinned candidate and obtain Tern disposition.

inputs.description: Observed baseline dev d74699a3d92a44bc4bee7f32754e9fd3b2a0a4c4, initially clean. DC-MP-R0C owns Windows stress, requested/achieved cadence, bounded cancellation/restoration and truthful stall attribution. Missing present observation keeps visible stall gate UNVERIFIED. Existing R14 review requests identity/trace/classification failures outrank bare binding loss while preserving MISSING/CORRUPT priority, actual finalize_result save/reload proof and explicit distinction between confirmed count and probe self-report. HEAD already contains R15 priority, delivery_attribution, probe_self_reported_delivered and six passing targeted regressions; no duplicate fix is presumed necessary. Current Tern reconciliation is pending in the restored existing conversation. ADR-0009 accepts technically completed slices, ADR-0012 releases Caller holds but not evidence requirements, ADR-0013 requires tracked latest evidence. Eleven historical N07 binary assertions stay NOT_RUN because original artifacts are absent. No Runtime mutation, main integration, release or invented measurement is authorized.

constraints.text: Reuse existing implementation. Do not change successful workload semantics, S2B original evidence, dependencies, GPUI pin or Runtime. No new field or abstraction without demonstrated need.
Distinguish saved FAILED diagnostic proof from real Native delivery. Unattributed probe actions are self-report, never confirmed measurements. Preserve missing present/GPU/N07 dispositions.

Existing coding agent owns repair and smoke; Taskern plans only. Use full committed Refine candidate, native status/inspect/verify and exact-SHA Tern review. Preserve failures, never redispatch unknown outcomes; latest sanitized evidence lives in tracked repository paths, not temp.

outputs.description: Necessary source repair, persisted behavioral proof, verification and pinned Gate/Tern disposition with explicit limitations.

acceptance.statement: Saved FAILED reason is PROBE_BINDING_LOST for binding-only loss and the correct higher-priority failure for binding plus pid, generation, launcher, title, trace or classification failure; corrupt/missing precedence remains.
Saved action self-report remains distinct from confirmed deliveries; success behavior is preserved and no unverified count becomes a measurement.
Independent pinned Gate and Tern review establish limited closure or a precise blocker; no unmeasured full-MP completion is claimed.

evaluation.requirement: Exercise actual finalize_result save/reload with independently specified failure identities, affected regressions and public development CLI. Tests do not claim real Native delivery.

Run affected Python verification and required impact-route checks, independent Refine integrity on full candidate and Tern fixed-SHA review. Do not count historical unavailable N07 assertions as PASS.
